defect: Handlebars template variables did not expand in three component registry key paths
introducedBy: the ICE30 fix in dffb3b1d6, which added OCX024NativeShim / OCX024NativeConsole by copying a neighbouring line
symptom: HKCU\Software\gz ers\OpenCodeX Desktop\023\Components was missing the NativeShim, NativeConsole and NativeEntrySource values after a real install
rootCause: those three lines used a single backslash before the variable, Software\{{manufacturer}}; Handlebars treats \{{ as an escape sequence, so the literal text {{manufacturer}}{{product_name}} was emitted into the key name

proof.renderedTemplateBefore: candidate-20261123-r1/generated-main.wxs lines 190/193/197 carry the literal placeholders, while lines 170/174/178/220/230 render correctly as Software\gzers\OpenCodeX Desktop\023\Components
proof.renderedTemplateAfter: all eight component registry keys now render as Software\gzers\OpenCodeX Desktop\023\Components

fix: changed those three lines to the double-backslash form already used elsewhere in the template (3 lines changed, no other edit)

verification.renderedOutput: target/release/wix/x64/main.wxs shows 8/8 component keys expanded correctly

notYetDone: no real MSI install has been run with the fixed package to confirm the values land at runtime
the earlier withdrawn 'context mixing' claim stays withdrawn; this defect explains the missing values, not the earlier 1605
